Sreenath Govindarajan

Founder

LinkedIn

Sreenath Govindarajan is the founder of Kanan Labs, a company building intelligence systems for markets shaped by regulation, trade, and institutional change.

His work focuses on turning fragmented external complexity into structured operating context. Kanan Labs is being built to help firms move from episodic interpretation toward continuous, system-level visibility.

His background spans law, business, and cross-jurisdictional regulatory analysis across India, the EU, the UK, the US, and Australia, with a focus on AI regulation, trade-linked legal structures, comparative systems, and industrial policy.
